cases.task: Choose the safe browser rule for a repeated ready handshake after native EventSource reconnect. The application last accepted cursor 950, but an unknown named SSE frame may have changed the browser internal Last-Event-ID to 975 without invoking an application listener.

required_facts.text: The application has certified and retained cursor 950.
An unknown named SSE frame can change EventSource internal Last-Event-ID without application code observing or validating that frame.
A reconnect ready at 975 would skip evidence not accepted by the application if treated as monotonic progress.
The repeated ready must equal the application last accepted cursor; either advance or rewind is a protocol failure requiring explicit reconnect or reset.
